subject: MSA / Order Form — insurance scope and acceptable evidence
body:
From: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@cloudwave.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Morales <treasury@cloudwave.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 12:08:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form — insurance scope and acceptable evidence

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for sending the draft Order Form. A couple of questions from our procurement and legal teams about the insurance section before we route to procurement:

- Limits: we need confirmation that Redwood will meet the listed cyber liability minimum of $5M and the tech E&O $3M across the term. Can you confirm whether the current vendor program meets this or if an exception is required?
- Additional insured: CloudWave requires Additional Insured naming on the GL and Auto but not on cyber. Is it possible for Redwood to provide an endorsement naming CloudWave as Additional Insured for GL & Auto only?
- Waiver of subrogation and primary/ non-contributory language: procurement is okay with usual language but requests a clean copy of the endorsement wording.

Please attach the standard spec and any sample endorsements.

Best,
Elena Garcia
Senior Counsel, CloudWave

---

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Tom Morales <treasury@cloudwave.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form — insurance scope and acceptable evidence

Elena — thanks for the quick read. Answers inline below and next steps at the bottom. Attaching our current insurance spec (Redwood_Insurance_Spec_v3.pdf) and the draft Order Form you asked about.

- Limits: Our standard program provides $5M cyber (umbrella-eligible for higher tiers) and $3M tech E&O. For very large commitments we can bump via umbrella; confirm if CloudWave expects a hard $5M cyber limit (not counting umbrella).
- Additional insured: Our broker typically provides AI on GL and Auto via a CG 20x endorsement. We do not name AI on cyber as a practice. If CloudWave needs a cyber AI, we need to escalate to our broker — this is non-standard and likely requires underwriter approval.
- Waiver of subrogation / primary & non-contributory: we can provide GLOA wording for GL/Auto; cyber policy language is controlled by insurer; we can provide covenant language in the Order Form (contractual) but insurer confirmation is separate.

Suggested next steps:
1) Aditya to confirm whether the contractual language we propose (Order Form paragraph + endorsement samples) is acceptable to Redwood Legal.
2) If CloudWave needs cyber AI or specific endorsement text, we will request the broker and share expected timeline (typically 7–10 business days for underwriter review).
3) If acceptable, we propose to deliver: (a) clean Order Form with contractual language, (b) sample endorsements (GL/Auto) as PDF, (c) broker contact and ETA for any cyber exceptions.

Rachel Kim
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Insurance_Spec_v3.pdf, OrderForm-DRAFT-CloudWave-20260715.pdf

---

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form — insurance scope and acceptable evidence

Rachel / Elena — looping in legal; quick comments:

- Contractual language: Redwood is comfortable with Order Form language that states Redwood will maintain the insurance program described in the attached spec and will provide certificates and standard GL/Auto endorsements naming CloudWave as Additional Insured.
- Cyber AI: we avoid promising insurer endorsements for cyber unless the underwriter confirms. For customers requesting cyber AI, we typically include a contractual commitment to use commercially reasonable efforts to obtain the endorsement and provide evidence of the request to the customer.
- Waiver / primary wording: we can accept primary/non-contributory for GL/Auto; for cyber, we propose a commitment to seek the waiver but tie it to insurer approval.

If CloudWave confirms they are okay with contractual commitments (plus broker escalation for any cyber AI), Legal can sign off and Rachel can proceed with certificates and endorsement samples.

Aditya Rao
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

---

From: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@cloudwave.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Morales <treasury@cloudwave.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 10:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form — insurance scope and acceptable evidence

Aditya — thanks for the clarity. Procurement is aligned to the approach below with two additions:

1) A one-time requirement for evidence delivery: Please provide the COI and GL/Auto endorsements prior to contract signature (or show broker confirmation of pending delivery).
2) Insurer contact: procurement would like broker contact info and a point person for follow-up on the cyber AI request in case underwriting needs clarification.

If Redwood can provide sample endorsements + broker contact and confirm timeline for underwriter review for cyber AI, CloudWave legal will proceed to signature with the contractual caveat you described.

Best,
Elena

---

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form — insurance scope and acceptable evidence

Elena — quick update and delivery plan:

- Attached: sample GL & Auto endorsement (CloudWave_Requested_Endorsement.docx) and the updated Redwood_Insurance_Spec_v3.pdf (same spec, added a short FAQ page).
- Broker: Aon Risk Services — broker contact is Priya Mehta, priya.mehta@aon.com (desk +1 312 555 0142). Priya will confirm whether the underwriter can/ will issue cyber AI and estimated timing.
- Timeline: we will submit the cyber-AI request to broker today (7/20). Expect broker acknowledgement within 1 business day and underwriter ETA 7–10 business days.
- Certificates / COIs: we can provide COIs and GL/Auto endorsements prior to signature. Cyber AI if granted will be provided as an amended endorsement as soon as underwriter signs off.

Next steps for CloudWave: please confirm if AI on GL/Auto only is sufficient (preferred) or if you must have cyber AI. If preferred, we can close the order quickly. If cyber AI is mandatory, we proceed with broker escalation.

Thanks — Rachel

Rachel Kim
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CloudWave_Requested_Endorsement.docx, Redwood_Insurance_Spec_v3.pdf
